data.name: Niharika
data.gender_notes: Niharika is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: One who brings radiance and shines brightly, derived from the Sanskrit words 'ni' meaning new, 'hari' meaning shining, and 'ka' meaning one. The name Niharika carries the meaning “Radiant, Shining One” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Hindi. Parents who choose Niharika usually hope their child will grow to embody radiant, shining one and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Represents the divine feminine energy and the inner light that shines within each individual.
data.etymology: Niharika belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Radiant, Shining One.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Niharika total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.
